title: He Saved 100,000 People, Then Vanished Without a Trace
description:
Raoul Wallenberg, a Swedish diplomat, issued protective passports that saved tens of thousands of Hungarian Jews in WWII. Soviet forces detained him in 1945, and he was never seen again.

Did you know this actually happened? Let me know in the comments.
